integrity_notes: The full proof and finite checks are supplied. Existing existence and uniqueness theorems are cited as prior work. Computational examples are not substituted for the asymptotic proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns a local multiplier for the unique period-two orbit, not a global basin or nondegenerate period-four bifurcation.
The limit applies only to sufficiently small positive symmetry defect; it imports the published unique-crossing and coarse localization theorem.
Published literature may contain unindexed equivalent asymptotics; no independent verification has been performed.
title: Exact exponentially small flip-gap constant in a near-symmetric replicator map
